text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fillies' Revue.
Having reached the Classic tier, the attention on Daiichi Ruby grew ever greater.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's so lively~! I guess everyone really did come to see the "Illustrious Clan."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No doubt. You normally don't see something like that! The other girls running with her must have a rough time too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"They'd steal all the spotlight, and their
skills are practically guaranteed, so...
If it were me, I might not want to run alongside them."

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There she is, the young lady...! 
What an incredible aura...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, there's no way I can win...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Look at that cool look on her face.
Like we're not even on her radar, huh?
Talk about provoking us...!

The sharp gazes of the Umamusume pierce into Daiichi Ruby.
Yet even through that—she brushed it aside with composure.
choice_data_list: (Doesn't she care about what the other girls are doing?)

text_block_list.text:
I wondered how she felt about the other runners.
Curious, I asked her frankly—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your research and analysis should have been thorough.
Was there anything else that caught your attention?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I mean...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, I have the utmost respect
for everyone who has journeyed this far as our opponents.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, I harbor no feelings beyond that.
The only one I must truly face is myself."

"Her only rival is herself... is that it?
That's truly stoic and so like her."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
—All runners,
please prepare for the race.

During her debut race, I wasn't able to offer her
the right words. Before this crucial race,
I want to make sure I tell her something today...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Today is just a prelude...
The ultimate goal is the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What I must do today is show that my abilities are worthy of the Tiara—
